# Learnings and mistakes

No structural facts are generated for this page; the store has no concept of a mistake, only of records, decisions and handovers. Everything here is written by hand.

## Notes (human, preserved verbatim on regeneration)

<!-- bm-human:begin -->
The full account is 08-WHAT-WORKED-AND-WHAT-FAILED.md. The short version:

WHAT WORKED WAS REFUSALS. A write blocked across a live claim, a second test
run blocked while another held the lock, a battery refusing to report green on
a tree edited mid-run, a close verifier refusing the session that wrote it, a
push scan catching a forbidden trailer in a public repository, and a docs
suite catching the pack's own prose. None of them needed anybody to remember
anything.

WHAT FAILED WAS JUDGEMENT. A finding filed from a summary named the wrong
file, and reproducing it moved the fix upstream. A claim was verified against
the wrong copy of the product. A measurement was taken over a moving tree. A
writer lane rebuilt work another session had already landed. And two delivered
claims were refuted by an adversarial pass.

THE PATTERN: fan out under fences, then attack what comes back. Every serious
finding came from that pairing; every error came from doing the first half and
skipping the second.
<!-- bm-human:end -->
